problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a delivery truck. Available packages are:
* Package 1: size 42 cubic feet, revenue $211
* Package 2: size 31 cubic feet, revenue $145
* Package 3: size 12 cubic feet, revenue $127
* Package 4: size 35 cubic feet, revenue $196
* Package 5: size 11 cubic feet, revenue $164
* Package 6: size 39 cubic feet, revenue $83
* Package 7: size 30 cubic feet, revenue $45
* Package 8: size 5 cubic feet, revenue $254
* Package 9: size 26 cubic feet, revenue $299
* Package 10: size 27 cubic feet, revenue $294
* Package 11: size 6 cubic feet, revenue $145
* Package 12: size 31 cubic feet, revenue $127
* Package 13: size 8 cubic feet, revenue $161
* Package 14: size 10 cubic feet, revenue $194
* Package 15: size 7 cubic feet, revenue $80
The truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 224 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
